description:

You make out a fridge. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting. You can see a closed oven here. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The table is massive. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Were you looking for a counter?
